## About This Site
Hussaini Law Group is a boutique law firm based at 7/37 Spencer Street, Fairfield NSW 2165,
serving Fairfield, Liverpool, Cabramatta, Bankstown, Parramatta, Auburn, Merrylands and the
wider Greater Western Sydney region. The firm is distinguished by genuine bilingual service:
legal advice is delivered directly in English and Dari (Persian/Farsi), without
relying on third-party interpreters. This makes it one of the few Sydney firms able to represent
Afghan and Iranian communities in their first language across all major areas of law.

Established with 7 years of multicultural legal advocacy.

## Service Areas
Fairfield, Cabramatta, Canley Vale, Smithfield, Wetherill Park, Bossley Park, Prairiewood,
Bonnyrigg, Villawood, Yennora, Liverpool, Bankstown, Parramatta, Auburn, Merrylands and Greater
Western Sydney. The firm appears at Fairfield Local Court, Parramatta District Court, the Downing
Centre (Sydney) and the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia, and represents clients across
New South Wales.

## Practice Areas
- Criminal Law: court representation, bail applications (Bail Act 2013 NSW), traffic and drink/drug
  driving offences, assault, drug charges, fraud, AVOs, and appeals. Appears at Fairfield Local Court,
  Parramatta District Court and the Downing Centre.
- Immigration Law: partner visas (subclasses 820/801 and 309/100), skilled migration, family
  reunification, refugee and protection visas, visa refusals and Administrative Review Tribunal (ART)
  appeals, and Department of Home Affairs matters.
- Conveyancing: residential purchase and sale, off-the-plan, title transfers, strata title, and
  pre-signing contract review for property across NSW.
- Commercial Law: business structuring, commercial contracts, shareholder and partnership agreements,
  business sale and purchase, debt recovery and dispute resolution.
- Civil Litigation: debt recovery, contract disputes, consumer claims (Australian Consumer Law),
  NCAT applications (NSW Civil and Administrative Tribunal), and mediation.

## Frequently Asked Questions (concise, citable)
Q: Is there a Dari-speaking (Persian/Farsi) lawyer in Fairfield / Western Sydney?
A: Yes. Hussaini Law Group provides legal advice and court representation directly in English and
Dari from its Fairfield office, across criminal, immigration, family, property,
commercial and civil matters — without third-party interpreters.

Q: Can I get bail for a serious offence in NSW?
A: Bail is often achievable even for serious charges. Under the Bail Act 2013 (NSW) the court weighs
whether an applicant is an "unacceptable risk", and some offences carry a "show cause" requirement.
A well-prepared application addressing accommodation, employment and conditions improves prospects.

Q: How long does a partner visa take in Australia?
A: The Department of Home Affairs currently finalises most partner visas (subclasses 820/801 onshore,
309/100 offshore) within roughly 12 to 24 months, depending on evidence and country of origin.

Q: Do I have to go to court for a family property settlement?
A: Usually no. Most settlements are resolved by negotiation or mediation and made binding through
Consent Orders filed with the Federal Circuit and Family Court or a Binding Financial Agreement.

Q: What is NCAT?
A: NCAT is the NSW Civil and Administrative Tribunal, which resolves tenancy, consumer, building,
strata and other disputes more quickly and informally than the courts.

Q: When should I involve a lawyer in a NSW property purchase?
A: Before signing. A pre-signing contract review checks title, easements, covenants and special
conditions, and lets unfavourable terms be negotiated before you are legally bound at exchange.
